_comment: Single source for every SDK's resource classes. Run `python3 tools/generate.py` after editing. kind: get = path params only, query = optional query string, list = optional query string and a paginated result, body = JSON body, delete = no body.

resources.name: customers
resources.doc: Your customers: the people and businesses you onboard.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.doc: Get a customer, including its endorsements.

resources.name: kyc
resources.doc: Submit and update customer KYC (individuals) and KYB (businesses).

methods.name: updateIndividual
methods.doc: Partially update an individual KYC submission.

methods.name: updateBusiness
methods.doc: Partially update a business KYB submission.

methods.name: resubmitEndorsement
methods.doc: Request or resubmit an endorsement (a service such as base, sepa or card_checkout) for a customer.

resources.name: lookups
resources.doc: Reference lists used to build KYC and KYB forms.

methods.name: subdivisions
methods.doc: List a country's states or provinces.

methods.name: postalCodeFormat
methods.doc: Get a country's postal code format.

methods.name: identificationTypes
methods.doc: List accepted ID document types for a country.

methods.name: individualSourceOfFunds
methods.doc: List sources of funds for individuals.

methods.name: businessSourceOfFunds
methods.doc: List sources of funds for businesses.

resources.name: paymentMethods
resources.doc: Discover payin (collection) and payout methods.

methods.name: payin
methods.doc: List payin methods. Pass country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3) and currency. Each method's id is the gateway for deposits.create.

methods.name: payinCountries
methods.doc: List countries you can collect payments in.

methods.name: payinCurrencies
methods.doc: List payin currencies for a country. Pass country (alpha-3).

methods.name: payoutCountries
methods.doc: List countries you can pay out to.

methods.name: payoutForm
methods.doc: Get the fields a payout method needs for a beneficiary.

resources.name: rates
resources.doc: Quotes, market rates and your fee schedule.

methods.name: quote
methods.doc: Create a quote. With method_id and method_type it locks the rate for 5 minutes and returns a quote_id.

methods.name: market
methods.doc: Live indicative market rates for display.

methods.name: fees
methods.doc: Your fees for every payin and payout method.

resources.name: deposits
resources.doc: Payins: collect money through local payment methods and cards.

methods.name: create
methods.doc: Create a deposit. Returns deposit_url, the hosted page to send your payer to.

methods.name: list
methods.doc: List deposits. Filter by gateway, currency, customer_id, start_date and end_date.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.doc: Get one deposit by its id or deposit_id. Use it to confirm status before you fulfil an order.

resources.name: cardCheckout
resources.doc: Card Checkout: hosted card payments for your customers' sales. Your account needs Card Checkout access.

methods.name: account
methods.doc: Your Card Checkout access, pricing and balance.

methods.name: requestAccess
methods.doc: Request Card Checkout access. Optional note.

methods.name: submitEndorsement
methods.doc: Submit a customer's card_checkout endorsement. Returns an onboarding_url.

methods.name: onboardingLink
methods.doc: Create a fresh onboarding link. Optional return_url and refresh_url.

methods.name: verification
methods.doc: Get the verification form, prefilled from the customer's KYB.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.doc: Create a checkout order. Send the buyer to the returned checkout_url.

methods.name: listOrders
methods.doc: List orders. Filter by status, customer_id and reference.

methods.name: retrieveOrder
methods.doc: Get an order. Act on its status, not on the buyer's redirect.

resources.name: virtualAccounts
resources.doc: Virtual bank accounts for your customers.

methods.name: create
methods.doc: Create a virtual account for a customer and currency.

methods.name: histories
methods.doc: Transactions into all your virtual accounts.

methods.name: currencies
methods.doc: Currencies you can issue and the endorsement each needs.

resources.name: wallets
resources.doc: Your balances.

resources.name: beneficiaries
resources.doc: Saved payout destinations.

methods.name: create
methods.doc: Add a beneficiary with gateway_id, payment_data, currency and nickname.

resources.name: payouts
resources.doc: Send money out of your wallets.

methods.name: create
methods.doc: Pay out from a wallet to a beneficiary.

resources.name: sendMoney
resources.doc: Quote and send transfers in one flow.

resources.name: swaps
resources.doc: Move balance between your own wallet currencies.

resources.name: transactions
resources.doc: Your transaction history.

methods.name: tracking
methods.doc: Tracking steps for a transaction, by quote ID.

methods.name: track
methods.doc: Track a transaction by ID (query parameters).

resources.name: virtualCards
resources.doc: Virtual cards for your customers.

methods.name: activateCustomer
methods.doc: Enable a customer for virtual cards.

methods.name: topUp
methods.doc: Top up a card from your USD wallet.

methods.name: withdraw
methods.doc: Move money from a card to your USD wallet.

methods.name: terminate
methods.doc: Terminate a card. The balance returns with the virtualcard.terminated.refund webhook.

resources.name: crypto
resources.doc: Stablecoin deposit addresses.

methods.name: createWallet
methods.doc: Create a deposit address, e.g. currency USDC_SOL. Store it: address requests are rate limited.

resources.name: corporateCards
resources.doc: Corporate cards for your business customers' employees (invitation only).

methods.name: changeCardStatus
methods.doc: Activate, suspend or replace a card.

resources.name: webhookEndpoints
resources.doc: Register the URL that receives your webhooks. One endpoint per account.

methods.name: create
methods.doc: Create or replace your endpoint (url). Returns a new secret: store it.

methods.name: update
methods.doc: Change the URL. The secret stays the same.

methods.name: regenerateSecret
methods.doc: Issue a new secret. The old one stops working at once.

resources.name: events
resources.doc: Webhook delivery log.

methods.name: resend
methods.doc: Resend an event to your current URL, signed with your current secret.

resources.name: ipWhitelist
resources.doc: Check your API key setup.

methods.name: check
methods.doc: Confirms the key works and whether this server's IP is allowed.

resources.name: sandbox
resources.doc: Sandbox-only helpers.

methods.name: simulateWebhook
methods.doc: Send a sample signed event (payin, payout, customer, ...) to your registered URL. Sandbox only.
